name: Gary Con
blurb: A tribute to D&D co-creator Gary Gygax, run by his son Luke Gygax, held each spring at the Grand Geneva Resort in Lake Geneva, Wisconsin.

editions.evidence: Site page title 'Gary Con XIX - Gary Con' and its og:image file 'gary-con-xix-scaled.png' (read via a Wayback Machine snapshot, see notes); dates and venue confirmed by search results from happeningnext.com and 10times.com: 'Gary Con XIX at 7036 Grand Geneva Way, Lake Geneva, WI... on 18th March, 2027' / 'Gary Con XIX is scheduled for March 18-21, 2027... Grand Geneva Resort & Spa'.

notes: The live site returns a Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' bot-check (HTTP 403) to extract.mjs even with --channel msedge, so it was read via a Wayback Machine snapshot (captured 2026-06-08, the most recent one archived) instead. That snapshot's nav still only links to the prior year's 'gary-con-xviii-special-guests' page (no XIX-specific guest page existed yet as of June 2026, and no newer snapshot was available), so guests are recorded as none-yet; re-check closer to the March 2027 show. Organizer entity beyond 'Gary Con' (run by Luke Gygax, son of D&D co-creator Gary Gygax) not found.
